cases.claim: Article 14 provides for equality before law and equal protection of the laws.
cases.source_text: 14. Equality before law. The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.

cases.claim: Section 45 addresses a landlord cutting off or withholding an essential supply or service.
cases.source_text: 45. Cutting off or withholding essential supply or service. No landlord either himself or through any person purporting to act on his behalf shall without just and sufficient cause cut off or withhold any essential supply or service enjoyed by the tenant.

cases.claim: The District Commission may direct replacement of goods where the legal conditions are met.
cases.source_text: Where the District Commission is satisfied that the goods complained against suffer from any of the defects specified in the complaint, it may issue an order to replace the goods with new goods of similar description which shall be free from any defect.

cases.claim: The Intermediary Rules refer to a grievance officer mechanism for user complaints.
cases.source_text: The intermediary shall prominently publish on its website, mobile based application or both, the name of the Grievance Officer and his contact details as well as mechanism by which a user or a victim may make complaint.

cases.claim: The Legal Services Authorities Act concerns providing free and competent legal services to eligible persons.
cases.source_text: The object is to provide free and competent legal services to the weaker sections of the society to ensure that opportunities for securing justice are not denied to any citizen by reason of economic or other disabilities.

cases.claim: The Human Rights Commission may inquire into complaints of violation of human rights or negligence by a public servant.
cases.source_text: The Commission shall perform functions including to inquire, suo motu or on a petition presented to it by a victim or any person on his behalf, into complaint of violation of human rights or abetment thereof or negligence in the prevention of such violation by a public servant.
cases.document_title: The Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993

cases.claim: The dark patterns guidelines address practices that mislead users or impair user autonomy.
cases.source_text: dark patterns means any practices or deceptive design pattern using user interface or user experience interactions on any platform that is designed to mislead or trick users to do something they originally did not intend or want to do by subverting or impairing the consumer autonomy, decision making or choice.
cases.document_title: Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

cases.claim: The misleading advertisement guidelines address advertisements that mislead consumers about a product or service.
cases.source_text: misleading advertisement in relation to any product or service means an advertisement which falsely describes such product or service or gives a false guarantee to, or is likely to mislead the consumers as to the nature, substance, quantity or quality of such product or service.
cases.document_title: Guidelines for Prevention of Misleading Advertisements, 2022

cases.claim: The Direct Selling Rules contain obligations for direct sellers.
cases.source_text: Obligations of direct sellers. Every direct seller shall have a prior written contract with the direct selling entity for undertaking sale of, or offer to sell, any goods or services.
